items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Folders moved to .shipwright/events/{drops,archive,quarantine}; hard abort on the old root location; migration tool; gitignore whitelist; docs. Config files and the legacy single file are untouched as specified.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Writers and evidence producers refuse an old root folder with the exact fix; the migration tool never overwrites, reports collisions before moving anything, and exits non-zero on git failure.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No secrets; the migration tool takes a project root only and moves files inside it; a symlink named like an old folder is not treated as one.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 15 new tests assert outcomes (refusal text, files on disk, git rename, gitignore probe via git check-ignore, integrity verdicts for move and three non-move shapes). Full shared, integration, scripts and all plugin roots ran; tests found and drove four real defects (first-segment assumption in the integrity check, reader kind detection, parents=True, test-side separators).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Path constants only; no new loops over data.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New tool follows the tools/ layout; new lib functions sit in events_sentinel (stdlib only). Bloat/size gates checked at F0.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer/consumer pairs listed in the spec: event writers/readers over the three folders, gitignore canon, integrity check over git diffs; WebUI is a cross-repo consumer tracked as the last step. Round trip covered by integration suites and the real git-mv PR test.
